late: You are marked late if you check in after your scheduled shift start time (e.g. 09:00 AM) beyond the 15-minute grace period. Accumulating three late check-ins in a month triggers a notification to your reporting manager.
absent: You are marked absent for any scheduled working day with no registered punch and no approved leave covering that day. Unexcused absences may impact pay calculation.
gracePeriod: PeoplePay360 allows a standard 15-minute grace period for morning check-in (up to 09:15 AM for a 09:00 AM shift) without being flagged as late.
shiftTimings: Standard general shift runs Monday to Friday from 09:00 AM to 06:00 PM (with a 1-hour lunch break). Flexible core hours are 10:00 AM to 04:00 PM.
overtime: Overtime is counted for any pre-approved work performed beyond the standard 8 working hours per day or on weekends. Overtime is compensated at 1.5x standard hourly rate or converted to compensatory off (comp-off).
biometricPunch: Punches can be recorded via the office biometric scanner, the PeoplePay360 mobile app with geofencing, or web clock-in when working remotely.
regularization: If you forgot to clock in or had technical issues with a punch, you can submit an Attendance Regularization request within 3 days under the Attendance page.
